why: The line with three dots turns a quarter turn each time: dots on top of the line, dots to the left, dots below, dots to the right. The next step is back to dots on top of the line, which is option 3. Option 1 has only two dots.
trick: Count the dots too - a correct direction with a wrong count is a trap.
